inputs.text: [deadpan] …so that's the whole pitch. You rent a conference room — nothing fancy, a Marriott ballroom, some folding chairs — and it's a workshop for English speakers who are dead serious about improving their Japanese accents.
Zane, buddy… [hesitant] this sounds — and I wanna be careful here — this sounds a little offensive.
[dryly] See, that's exactly why it's for serious people only.
Because if anybody laughs, [firmly] they're out. Escorted from the building. This is academic.

[laughs] Okay, so picture the instructor up front. [doing a Japanese accent] "Okay everyone, prease repeat after me. Wercome to da conference, dis way to da seminar." And nobody's allowed to crack up?
[deadpan] Stone faces. Clipboards out. [doing a Japanese accent] "Berry good. Now we order da chicken teriyaki, prease. Extra rice."
[bursts out laughing] You just laughed at your own —
[interrupting, flat] I'm the instructor. I'm allowed. [beat] You, though — you'd be ejected.

[proudly] "Certified. Eight-week program." There's a final exam, too. You gotta order a full meal — [doing a Japanese accent] "I rike da ramen, extra noodo, no onion, sankyu" — without one single witness smiling.
[sighs] And if one guy in the back giggles?
[flatly] Whole class fails. Everybody pays again.
